title: Hypher Launch
logline: For builders who switch between Claude Code and Codex on one repo: stop re-explaining your project. The next agent starts from one note. Join the pilot at hypher.app.

scenes.intent: The pain: you are typing your project's context into yet another agent, again.

beats.note: the Codex prompt is there; typing starts

text.prompt-text: Again: hash tokens, don’t widen OAuth…
text.headline: Every agent starts from zero.

Label 8px above the prompt, grey
<Input ct="prompt" focus> ~1120px wide, empty value; types into prompt-text, caret prompt-caret (accent as light)

scenes.motion: Solid canvas. b1 (0.15): agent fades, prompt rises (responsive); m.type("prompt-text", { at: 0.3, cps: 22 }) runs to ~2.0, with m.blink("prompt-caret") until the end. b2 (0.7): headline maskUp split lines, ease expressive (the scene's one moment). Camera push 1 → 1.03 over the whole scene, origin on the headline's left edge ({ x: 96, y: 400 }), still moving on the last frame. JOIN OUT (cut on action): no exit; the push and the blinking caret are live at the cut, and the turn's statement rises on its frame 0. The light page cuts to black smoke as the answer arrives.

scenes.motion: Solid canvas. JOIN IN (carry up, 10%, layers from writeback): headline on screen from frame 0, arriving with the wave. Both panes, save-term (Claude Code) and codex-term (Codex CLI, idle: resume's pane in its slot), are on screen at full opacity from frame 0 and move by translate only (y 32 → 0, responsive), travelling up with the carry. 0.4: caption fades. b1 (0.55): m.type("save-cmd", { cps: 20 }) to ~1.15 (the box fades in at b1, then the text types). b2 (1.2): save-out rises, ease expressive (the one moment: saved). Camera: frame 0 at 1.02 on the headline's left edge, easing back to 1 (inOut) from 0.3 to go: the hold's ambient life, at rest on the identity before the command moves, so the match cut lines both panes up pixel for pixel (a push would end 2% in, and both panes would jump at the cut). go (2.7): JOIN OUT (match v2): save-cmd tweens x 0 → 360 over the last 0.6s on t², { type: "bezier", p: [1/3, 0, 2/3, 1/3] }, ending at end, so it is fastest on the last frame (v ≈ 1200 px/s); as it leaves it uncovers save-echo, the command's grey trace, laid under the box once the box is opaque (after save-cmd's fade, unseen until then). Nothing else moves; the caption stays put (it is paired).

scenes.motion: Solid canvas. JOIN IN (match from save, 0.8s, pairs save-cmd → resume-cmd and caption): resume-cmd leaves the cut at save-cmd's speed (≈ 1200 px/s rightward) and slows into place in the Codex pane by 0.8. Both panes are the ones save showed (Claude Code keeps its output and the command's grey echo where the box left; resume-term is save's codex-term), so only the command moves and the headline swaps. resume-cmd has no entrance of its own. b1 (0.4): headline maskUp lines, ease expressive (the one moment). b2 (1.15): resume-out rises (responsive), a beat after the command lands, as a terminal prints. Everything is settled by ~1.5. No caret, no push, no motion after it, so trust's still of this frame is exact. JOIN OUT (portal out via trust's machine-screen, 1.0s from 2.6): the whole shot shrinks into the screen on 'Your machine'.
